d: In this video, Firstpost takes a look at Donald Trump's latest bizarre remark about Israel. The US President has joked that he would happily move to Israel and even become its prime minister if Americans ever got tired of him. From wanting the Nobel Peace Prize to eyeing Greenland, Trump has never been short of ambitions. But there's an unexpected twist. Trump also says the US is stopping four billion dollars in aid to Israel. So, while he appears keen to move to Israel, his administration is reportedly tightening the purse strings. Is this Trump's next big career move? Hem Kaur Saroya
